title: Anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Anchor: clear simple shapes on dark screen -->
  <!-- Ring at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='5'/>
  <!-- Shank -->
  <rect x='46' y='26' width='8' height='48' rx='4' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <!-- Stock (crossbar) -->
  <rect x='28' y='34' width='44' height='8' rx='4' fill='#4DD0E1'/>
  <!-- Rounded ends on stock -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='38' r='5' fill='#80DEEA'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='38' r='5' fill='#80DEEA'/>
  <!-- Arms / flukes at bottom, curved -->
  <path d='M50 74 C 38 74, 24 68, 20 58 L 30 60 C 33 67, 41 68, 50 68 Z' fill='#FF6F91'/>
  <path d='M50 74 C 62 74, 76 68, 80 58 L 70 60 C 67 67, 59 68, 50 68 Z' fill='#FF6F91'/>
  <!-- Fluke tips highlights -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='58' r='4.5' fill='#FFA8B8'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='58' r='4.5' fill='#FFA8B8'/>
  <!-- Crown point at bottom of shank -->
  <path d='M50 74 L 44 82 L 50 76 L 56 82 Z' fill='#FFE082'/>
</svg>
